title: Claims Payments: Partner Agency Direct-Bill Invoices under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement
content:
**Basis.** Under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, a partner agency's direct-bill invoice is paid for the claim's most recently closed rental. The following details of that rental are read from the rental ledger:
- its start date;
- the daily rate recorded on its authorization;
- its closing end date;
- why it closed;
- its authorized days, meaning the authorization plus every extension of it.

An invoice number already paid is never paid again. Everything on the invoice that is not paid is the customer's responsibility.

## Effect of a payment

Each payment records one agency payment on the claim's rental ledger for the invoice given. The entry shows the invoice number, the rental days and daily rate the invoice bills, and the amount Cardinal pays the agency. The amount paid is added to the rental benefit paid on the option, and the agency can be told the invoice is paid.

## Tool

The tool is `pay_partner_rental_invoice_bf34992c`, an agent-side tool. The representative unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_coverage_id` | Reference number of the rental reimbursement option the rental is paid under, from the rental option lookup for the damaged vehicle | Identifier |
| `customer_id` | Customer reference number of the named insured, from the customer profile lookup | Identifier |
| `claim_number` | Physical damage claim number of the loss, from the claim or rental ledger lookup | Identifier |
| `authorization_number` | Rental authorization number the invoice bills, as shown on that authorization's entries in the rental ledger lookup | Identifier |
| `invoice_number` | Agency invoice number exactly as printed on the invoice or on the closing copy the customer reads out | Verbatim: copied character for character, every letter, digit and hyphen kept, no reformatting |
| `days_billed` | Number of rental days the invoice bills, as printed on it | Whole number of days |
| `daily_rate` | Daily rate the invoice bills, taxes and fees included, as printed on it | US dollars, 2 decimal places |
| `amount` | Amount Cardinal pays the agency on this invoice | US dollars, 2 decimal places, positive |

## Return

On success the tool returns:
- the word "paid" as the status;
- the reference number of the agency payment entry;
- the invoice paid;
- the amount paid (US dollars, 2 decimal places);
- the payment date (YYYY-MM-DD).

## Basis Q&A

- *An invoice arrives bearing a number that already shows as paid on the ledger.* It is never paid again.
- *Part of the invoice is not paid.* That part is the customer's responsibility.
